title: chore: defect hunt (11-03 #13): file 2-4 evidence-backed bug rows from Claude account rotation (daemon side, CLI and /ws account messages) and the server plumbing (McpAdapter dispatch, the /runner channel, health, bind and Origin checks)
description:
Filed by the governor at 22:08Z on 2026-11-03. It runs in parallel with hunt #12 (task-f6f0b580), on disjoint lanes.

WHY. After the 22:00Z account reset, 7 coders are idle and 0 WORKING rows are claimable. QA is clearing rows in 2-4 minutes each. PLANNING holds 5 rows plus hunt #12, and the hunt rows keep the coders fed after those.

LANE. Search in this order of preference:
1. Claude account rotation, daemon side: packages/moe-daemon/src/accounts/{claudeAuth,cli,registry,usageWindows,vmTokens}.ts, src/state/accountStore.ts, src/server/accountMessages.ts and the /ws account messages in WebSocketServer.ts (ADD_ACCOUNT, MOVE_ACCOUNT, REMOVE_ACCOUNT, RENAME_ACCOUNT, SET_ACCOUNT_SWITCH_PERCENT). Check them against docs/MCP_SERVER.md **Claude Account Rotation** (from :3180) and the account rows of docs/CONFIGURATION.md. Look for a switch percent, lease, reset-time, usage-window, sign-out or file-format rule that the docs promise and the code doesn't implement, or two paths (the `accounts` CLI, the /ws messages, lease_account, chat_wait's accountSwitch, start_step's ACCOUNT-SWITCH refusal) that disagree on the same rule. Today's 21:17Z "Every signed-in Claude account ... retry at 22:00Z" wait is a live sample in the logs. Already fixed, so don't re-file: 0c78c290 (lease presence during an all-spent wait), a7d02ec3 (the launcher attempt pin after the wait), 649edbbb (MOE_CLAUDE_NOT_FOUND), 55710898 and 3a98393f (protected-profile lookups), and 16ec5641 (the mod's /exit during a limit wait).
2. Server plumbing: src/server/McpAdapter.ts (tools/call dispatch, error coding, cancellation, and the `blocking`/mutex metadata the registry in src/tools/index.ts declares), src/server/runnerChannel.ts (the /runner host key), healthHost.ts, bindHosts.ts, probeHost.ts and the WebSocket Origin check. Look for a tool whose registry metadata contradicts what it does, an error path that drops the error code, or an endpoint rule in the root CLAUDE.md "Run" section or docs/ARCHITECTURE.md that the code doesn't enforce. Already fixed: 724e31fa and 801272c4 (Origin and the WSL bind).

Skip:
- Hunt #12's lanes, so the two hunts never file the same finding: the board-edit tools (createTask, deleteTask, archiveTask, createEpic, updateEpic, archiveEpic, deleteEpic, setTaskDependencies, setTaskPriority, addComment, declareFiles) and the /ws task, epic, comment and settings mutation handlers.
- Hunt #10's /ws lane: APPROVE_PROPOSAL and REJECT_PROPOSAL.
- scripts/mods/** and scripts/moe-account-lease.mjs, which hunt #6 covered. A finding there counts only if it's a contract mismatch with the daemon side of lane 1, and you cite both ends.
- Every file an open row holds. At filing time that is scripts/moe-agent.{sh,ps1}, scripts/tests/postflight-vm-route.ps1, scripts/tests/parity-check.{sh,ps1}, scripts/tests/postflight-fake-proxy.js (e76f32a0), claimNextTask.ts (6cf09180), waitForTask.ts, getPendingQuestions.ts and util/taskPayload.ts (b7203d89, c8618ccd), getActivityLog.ts (72f02ef3), util/metrics.ts (83cf11f5) and submitPlan.ts/util/rails.ts (dd1e00f8).
- Run `node /mnt/d/moe-scratch/governor/lanes.js -v` when you start, because the list moves.

Already known, so don't re-file: everything filed on 2026-11-03 (grep .moe/tasks for the file or tool name before you file), plus the held items listed in task-afe61cc0's description.

EVIDENCE BAR. Same as hunts #2-#11. Work only from real evidence:
- A repro on HEAD a3330bce or later: the command and its observed output, run in a git archive or clone snapshot outside the shared checkout. Global rail: never build or test in place. Never touch the machine's real account list: point MOE_ACCOUNTS_FILE at a scratch copy.
- A failure line from today's logs: the file and the timestamp.
- For a family or doc gap: the file:line that applies the rule, the file:line that skips it (or the doc line), and a test or call that shows the difference.
No speculative or style-only findings.

OUTPUT AND HOW TO FINISH. This row produces no code and no plan, so do not call moe.submit_plan.
1. File each finding with moe.create_task in the epic that owns the code. Use status PLANNING, and add no dependsOn unless a real logic edge exists. In worktree mode a shared file gets a placement note, not an edge. Each row gets a problem statement, the evidence, a fix direction and 2-3 checkable DoD items. Prefer rows QA can check with one vitest file. Each row syncs its own docs/MCP_SERVER.md section when the behavior it documents changes (ruling msg-71db57ac).
2. Post the ids, or "nothing real", in #governors and mention the governor (governor-e6b40560).
3. Archive this row yourself with moe.archive_task.
definitionOfDone: 2-4 new bug rows are filed in the epics that own the code, or "nothing real" is posted. Either way the outcome is posted in #governors.

Every filed row cites its evidence: a repro on HEAD a3330bce or later run outside the shared checkout (with a scratch MOE_ACCOUNTS_FILE for any account repro), a failure line from today's logs, or a rule/skip (or doc/code) file:line pair.
No filed row targets a file an open row holds (per lanes.js at hunt time) or duplicates a hunt #12 lane. The holder archives this row once the ids are posted.
